workloads.label: sincnet-speaker-local
workloads.reason: manifest full workload (SincNet-style speaker CNN local pooling); general-grid path; largest traffic (27.96 MB) -> primary optimisation target; target Ratio >= 70% | R1a CH=64->80 removed the C=80 channel-tail padding waste (num_logical 3392->2080, lanes -37%); 301.94 -> 188.45 us (-37.6%), bit-exact; not at target (ratio 13.7% -> 14.8%)

workloads.label: textcnn-global
workloads.reason: manifest full workload (TextCNN-style global temporal max pooling); L_out==1 -> C4 whole-line reduction path; target Ratio >= 70% | R1b equal-cost NaN tracking (isnan(reduce_sum(x*x)) in-place square, PL-1.22 (8)) replaced the eq-mask + reduce_min chain, and the reduced footprint allowed CH=128; 12.71 -> 11.62 us (-8.6%), bit-exact; not at target (ratio 18.3% -> 20.1%) -- 70% needs 3.33 us, below the 3.37 us empty-kernel floor, so unreachable (see perf_feedback.md)

workloads.label: ecg-cnn-dilated
